# Asbjørns Resource Sheet
This tool aim to give an overview over all resources from skills and monsters and their uses.
The tool also provides a 3D Printer planner, for planning out your resource investment goals and atom production.

# Google Sheet Link
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1WmkzuDiF8yoPQxJ5auBzyAZODJEEB7mCxWCIcF1uhGY/edit?gid=1457568749#gid=1457568749

https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1060586674104578098/1349473794376597504/Sprite-0002.gif?ex=67d33ae8&is=67d1e968&hm=a7c7cf95bec0b5e249933bf8ae2581e0f452b6ea638c9bc2ffe5c61b8d9b6730&=&width=1085&height=543

## Easy resource navigation
Every resource shows which meta system it feeds into, Alchemy even has notes with 90% and 95% bubble efficiency thresholds.

*Also did you know every resource name is a direct link to it's awesome wiki page?*

https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1060586674104578098/1349473962731503739/Sprite-0001.gif?ex=67d33b10&is=67d1e990&hm=2604e36268e8e9c34b7165145bde6506e3a7f22bae57ea361eb1e954596a1de1&=&width=867&height=543

The 3D Printer is easy to set up with just a few clicks.
The provided mockup includes the latest setup from Trialpear.
*Make sure to check out his work https://discord.com/channels/437797104786604034/1303887857324265514*
